svg.title: SEQUENDI RATIO — two geometric keys for the red heading
svg.desc: The first eight red runes S H E O G M IA F are reversed by rune order to F IA M G O E H S. Subtracting X N X C X N X C modulo 29 gives the literal runes SECUENDI. The four-rune key is read clockwise from the upper-left corner of a rectangle. SEQUENDI is the Latin interpretation, reading C/K as Q. The second red word S Y E NG C minus J TH TH J TH gives RATIO. Its source J R TH becomes J TH TH through the center totient phi(4)=2, with phase 0. The proposed Latin heading means a method of following. The GP sums are 352 and 205; their total 557 is prime and both Euler totients equal 160.

g.aria-label: Latin reading · A method of following
